name: Gmail backfill sync
description: Thread-based Gmail backfill into Tenant Data. Requires backfill_after start date. Re-run while backfill_status=running.

steps.name: Build backfill query and page token
steps.script:
local row = {}
if steps.read_sync_state.result and steps.read_sync_state.result.row then
  row = steps.read_sync_state.result.row
end
local after = input.backfill_after or "2026/01/01"
local page = input.backfill_page_token or row.backfill_page_token
local query = input.backfill_query or row.backfill_query or ("in:inbox after:" .. after)
return {
  query = query,
  page_token = page,
  connection_id = row.connection_id or input.connection_id or "",
  mailbox_email = row.mailbox_email,
  last_history_id = row.last_history_id or input.last_history_id or "",
  poll_interval_seconds = row.poll_interval_seconds or input.poll_interval_seconds or 120,
}

steps.name: Flatten thread messages

for_each_body_steps.name: Map thread message attachments
for_each_body_steps.script:
local msg = steps.get_full.result
local max = input.max_attachment_bytes or 5242880
local att_rows = {}
if msg.attachments then
  for _, a in ipairs(msg.attachments) do
    table.insert(att_rows, {
      external_id = run.external_id,
      gmail_id = msg.id,
      attachment_id = a.attachment_id,
      thread_id = msg.thread_id,
      filename = a.filename,
      mime_type = a.mime_type,
      size_bytes = a.size,
      synced_at = input.synced_at,
      source = "backfill",
    })
  end
end
local small = {}
local skipped = {}
for _, a in ipairs(att_rows) do
  if a.size_bytes and a.size_bytes > max then
    a.download_status = "skipped_size"
    table.insert(skipped, a)
  else
    table.insert(small, a)
  end
end
local labels = msg.label_ids or {}
local is_archived = true
local is_trashed = false
for _, lid in ipairs(labels) do
  if lid == "INBOX" then is_archived = false end
  if lid == "TRASH" then is_trashed = true end
end
return {
  thread_row = {
    external_id = run.external_id,
    thread_id = msg.thread_id,
    subject = msg.subject,
    snippet = msg.snippet,
    participants = { msg.from },
    label_ids = labels,
    message_count = 1,
    last_message_at = msg.date,
    is_archived = is_archived,
    is_trashed = is_trashed,
    synced_at = input.synced_at,
    source = "backfill",
  },
  message_row = {
    external_id = run.external_id,
    gmail_id = msg.id,
    thread_id = msg.thread_id,
    subject = msg.subject,
    from_email = msg.from,
    to_email = msg.to,
    cc_email = msg.cc,
    snippet = msg.snippet,
    body_text = msg.body_text,
    body_html = msg.body_html,
    label_ids = labels,
    has_attachments = msg.has_attachments,
    received_at = msg.date,
    is_deleted = false,
    synced_at = input.synced_at,
    source = "backfill",
  },
  small_attachments = small,
  skipped_attachments = skipped,
}

for_each_body_steps.name: Map attachment row with bytes
for_each_body_steps.script:
local att = item
local dl = body.download_attachment.result or {}
local row = {
  external_id = att.external_id,
  gmail_id = att.gmail_id,
  attachment_id = att.attachment_id,
  thread_id = att.thread_id,
  filename = att.filename,
  mime_type = att.mime_type,
  size_bytes = att.size_bytes,
  synced_at = att.synced_at,
  source = att.source,
}
if dl.data and dl.data ~= "" then
  row.download_status = "downloaded"
  row.content_base64 = dl.data
  row.storage_ref = "inline:" .. att.gmail_id .. "/" .. att.attachment_id
else
  row.download_status = "failed"
end
return row

steps.name: Update backfill checkpoint
steps.script:
local token = steps.flatten_messages.result.next_page_token
local status = "complete"
local page = nil
if type(token) == "string" and token ~= "" then
  status = "running"
  page = token
end
local after = input.backfill_after or "2026/01/01"
local bq = steps.build_query.result or {}
return {
  external_id = run.external_id,
  connection_id = bq.connection_id or input.connection_id or "",
  mailbox_email = bq.mailbox_email,
  last_history_id = bq.last_history_id or "",
  backfill_status = status,
  backfill_page_token = page,
  backfill_query = bq.query or ("in:inbox after:" .. after),
  last_sync_at = input.synced_at,
  poll_interval_seconds = bq.poll_interval_seconds or 120,
}

backfill_after.description: Gmail after: date — required lower bound, e.g. 2026/01/01

backfill_query.description: Optional full Gmail query; default in:inbox after:{backfill_after}

backfill_page_token.description: Resume pagination from prior run (from gmail_sync_state)

max_attachment_bytes.description: Skip gmail_get_attachment when size_bytes exceeds this (default 5242880)
